thought.text: 4GB free now. The boards build should complete. Let me wait:

reasoning_content: Memory has been freed up — currently 4GB is available. The board build should speed up. Let's wait for the board build to complete.

action.command:
for i in $(seq 1 9); do
  if curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:37315/ 2>/dev/null; then echo "boards responding at check $i"; break; fi
  sleep 55
done
curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "boards direct: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:37315/ 2>/dev/null || echo "boards not yet"; tail -3 /workspace/.urbo/workspace/logs/boards.log
